text:
Jordan: hey team — planning to work from Cape Town for ~4 months starting Sep 5. Quick Qs: how does the WFH stipend get pro-rated, will this trigger local payroll/tax nexus, and what's the process for shipping my company laptop and keeping benefits?

Emily (People Ops): congrats! short answers first: stipend is pro-rated by days in the month; payroll usually stays US-based for a short-term remote stint but we need to run a tax nexus check; benefits typically remain active while on US payroll. please fill the Homebase change form (https://forms.redwood/homebase-change) with dates and address.

Jordan: thanks. do i need formal approval for >90 days? i'm at ~4 months so worried about crossing any thresholds.

Olga (People Ops): good question. >183 days often creates tax residency, but local rules matter. 4 months (~120 days) typically doesn't automatically create SA tax residency, but because rules vary we do a Nexus review. please put exact travel dates and whether you'll be doing any local client work in the form. also note passport/visa status.

Jordan: i'll be only remote work for the US product team, no local clients. dates Sep 5 - Jan 10.

Sanjay (Finance): quick stipend note: baseline WFH stipend = $200/month. we pro-rate by days present in a month. payroll timing: stipends are paid on the next payroll run after expense/notes processed. laptop shipping: raise an IT ticket and we'll either ship spare hardware or reimburse shipping via expense report.

Payroll Bot: payroll reminder: employee stays on US payroll unless TaxOps determines a local payroll obligation. to trigger a nexus review submit the tax-nexus form: https://forms.redwood/tax-nexus. typical turnaround = 3-5 business days.

Jordan: any impact on health insurance or other benefits? international coverage questions.

Emily (People Ops): health insurance remains active while on US payroll. coverage abroad varies by plan — check the Benefits Portal or open benefits-ask for confirmation. If you need supplemental travel health or evacuation coverage we can advise. international phone stipend: still eligible; keep receipts for any provider changes.

Olga (People Ops): next steps recap for you @Jordan: 1) Homebase change form (link above) 2) Tax-nexus form (link above) 3) IT ticket for laptop shipping or request spare 4) Run a calendar block and notify your manager. once forms are in we'll loop in TaxOps and Legal for any immigration/payroll flags.

Sanjay (Finance): example pro-rate calc for clarity:
```
# pro-rate example
days_in_location = 26  # Sep 5-30
month_days = 30
stipend = 200
prorated = round(days_in_location/month_days*stipend)  # $173
```

Jordan: :thumbsup: filing now. thanks all.

Emily (People Ops): i'll watch for your submissions and ping TaxOps when received. cc @Sanjay for stipend processing :eyes:.

Payroll Bot: created ticket #4521 to track this case; will update thread after Nexus review completes.
